text: dsh-software-tools 是面向 DSH Web 的本机软件工具清单管理插件。它在侧栏提供按类别浏览和勾选的面板，并将选中的工具用法写入每次模型请求的系统提示，让模型知道本机有哪些可调用的软件及其使用方式。内置清单覆盖下载、代理、浏览器自动化、运行时和压缩等类别，也会合并用户目录中的自定义工具。选择保存在 DSH 数据目录，可通过设置更改位置；面板支持刷新，选项变化会反映到后续请求中。适合希望让 DSH 了解自己本机 WSL 或 Windows 工具的用户。插件本身不要求额外 API 密钥。

dsh-software-tools adds a local software inventory to DSH Web. Users select tools in a sidebar, and selected usage notes enter each request’s system prompt. Selections are stored locally. The catalog covers downloads, proxies, browser automation, runtimes, and compression. No API key is required.
想让 DSH 知道我这台电脑装了哪些命令行工具。
能不能在侧边栏勾选本机软件，并让模型之后按说明调用？
I want the model to know which local WSL or Windows utilities are available and how to use them.
dsh-software-tools 的功能「勾选本机软件」：侧栏面板按类别展示清单并允许切换选择；选择会保存到本机状态文件，面板也可刷新目录。
dsh-software-tools 的功能「注入工具用法」：每次组装系统提示时读取当前选择，将对应软件名称和用法整理成一段提示内容，供模型在后续请求中参考。

dsh-software-tools README · dsh-software-tools：Sidebar **🔧 软件工具** manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web. Maintain a curated inventory of local software — WSL CLI tools and Windows apps reachable via interop — and check the ones you want the model to know about. The checked set is injected into the model's system prompt as a compact section, so every session knows what software exists on this machine and how to call it. 中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

dsh-software-tools README · Problem：A model (e.g. deepseek-v4-flash) has no idea that you have IDM, ComfyUI, Obsidian, aria2… installed, let alone how to invoke each one. This plugin turns "local software inventory + invocation recipes" into a **checkable, persisted, auto-injected** system-prompt section: the model reads the `usage` field and runs the ready-made command.

dsh-software-tools README · Features：| | Capability | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🔧 | Sidebar panel | Tools grouped by category; toggling takes effect on the model's very next request — no restart |
| 📥 | Built-in + user catalog merge | Portable built-in catalog (aria2 / proxy / playwright / uvx / interop / zstd …); user entries in `catalog.json` override built-ins by id |
| 🧠 | System-prompt injection | Checked tools become a compact section on every assembly (`systemPrompt.section`, same seam as persona / plan-mode) |
| 🛠 | Bundled skill | Ships `add-software-tool`: the model learns to write newly installed software into the user catalog — no rebuild, no restart; entries are scoped to usage, not tuning |
| 🔒 | Loopback RPC | Panel ↔ host over a loopback-pinned RPC channel; reads local JSON only |

dsh-software-tools README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-software-tools
```

If your pnpm supply-chain policy blocks `dsh plugin add`, install manually: copy the package into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/` and append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-software-tools
      name: dsh-software-tools
      config: {}

Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). A **软件工具** row appears in the panel rail (between Automation tasks and Task Board).

dsh-software-tools README · Configuration：All optional; zero-config by default:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `settingsDir` | `$DSH_HOME/software-tools` | State directory holding `selection.json` + `catalog.json` |

dsh-software-tools README · State files：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `<settingsDir>/selection.json` | `{"ids": ["aria2", …]}` — current selection |
| `<settingsDir>/catalog.json` | `{"tools": [entry…]}` — user catalog; same id overrides a built-in |

Entry fields: `id` (`[a-z0-9-]{1,32}`, unique), `name`, `category` (`download`/`proxy`/`media`/`browser`/`knowledge`/`runtime`/`model`/`misc`), `desc` (≤40 chars, panel only), `usage` (**≤5 directly executable lines**, injected into the system prompt).

dsh-software-tools README · State files：> **An entry is usage instructions only**: written for the session that is about to call the tool — what it is, when to use it, the first command to run. Tuning/ops/troubleshooting/history (VRAM gates, quantisation and KV flags, measured throughput, port-change steps, migration history…) does not belong here; it belongs in the tool's own docs (README / deploy report / cheat sheet), with at most a `details in <path>` pointer. The entry is injected on every request, so length is cost — and tuning needs far more context than a few lines.

dsh-software-tools README · Adding a tool：Tell the model "add XXX to 软件工具" — the bundled `add-software-tool` skill researches the software and writes it into `catalog.json` (no rebuild, no restart; visible on panel refresh). You can also edit `catalog.json` by hand.

dsh-software-tools README · How it works：- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): registers `systemPrompt.section` (`software-tools`, order 200) rendered from the current selection, plus the loopback RPC channel `/ _dsh-software-tools` (`list` / `set`).
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`): contributes two official seats — `sidebar.panellist` (list: the rail row, whose `id` is the panel key and whose `label` is a thunk so the title follows the active locale) and `main` (keyed: the panel body the layout renders in the centre). Both wait on `ctx.slots.inject(key, ...)` for ui-layout / ui-sidebar to declare the seat. Built by `tsdown` into a lazy-CJS `__ModuleLoader__` bundle (React comes from the host shell).
- **Skill** (`skills/add-software-tool/`): mounted via `dsh-skill-filesystem`'s `customSkillDirs`, scoped to the plugin's own directory so user skill roots stay untouched.
